title: Why Do We Need Water?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Need Water.
Water carries stuff in blood and sweat.
Let me show you that in 3D.
It helps cool you and keeps cells working.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Thirst is a helpful alarm. Drink up.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Your body is mostly water.
The pictures today are a new water world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we need water.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
